description: Source code for LocalHTTPD class, a custom HTTP server extending NanoHTTPD, used for serving files over WiFi in an Android environment. It handles directory listing, file serving with range support, and HTTPS configuration.

classes.name: LocalHTTPD
classes.description: A custom HTTP server extending NanoHTTPD, serving files and directories, supporting HTTPS, and handling range requests and directory listings.

methods.name: canServeUri
methods.description: Checks if a given URI can be served from the specified home directory.

methods.name: encodeUri
methods.description: URL-encodes parts of the URI, encoding spaces as '%20'.

methods.name: findIndexFileInDirectory
methods.description: Finds an index file (like index.html) in a directory.

methods.name: getForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Returns a 403 Forbidden response with a message.

methods.name: getInternalErrorResponse
methods.description: Returns a 500 Internal Server Error response with a message.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Generates an HTML listing of directory contents.

methods.name: addResponseHeaders
methods.description: Adds headers to responses to disable keep-alive and GZIP, and sets Content-Security-Policy.

methods.name: newFixedLengthResponse
methods.description: Creates a fixed-length response with headers.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Handles the response for a given URI.

methods.name: defaultRespond
methods.description: Default response handler for serving files or directories.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Main entry point for serving HTTP requests.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests, specifically for /request-swap endpoint.

methods.name: serveFile
methods.description: Serves a file with support for range requests and caching headers.

methods.name: newFixedFileResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for serving a file.

methods.name: enableHTTPS
methods.description: Configures HTTPS for the server using a keystore.
